node.title: PROVED (autonomous #45, sympy-verified): the h=3 (a,b,t) parametrization
node.statement: For P = {1,a,b} in mu_n (odd char), every nontrivial affine triple (x,y,z) with the same top-2 elementary symmetric sums is x(t),y(t),z(t) = explicit deg-2/deg-2 rational functions of one parameter t, D = t^2+t+1 != 0; converse holds. BOTH symmetric-sum identities verified identically zero by independent sympy simplification (not just the packet verifier). This is the exact base object of the h=3 active-core count: C_3^nt = #{(a,b,t): a,b,x(t),y(t),z(t) in H, non-permutation, non-toral}.
node.notes: Autonomous-mode proof, independently re-derived here. The h=3 active-core problem is now an EXACT rational-incidence count in 3 variables — the sharpest handle on the terminal node. | CUBIC CAP PROVED (#46, independently verified): x(t) in H forces t to be a root of the nonzero degree-<=2n polynomial N_x(t)^n - D(t)^n (nonzero because N_x = D => a=b=1, invalid) — so <= 2n partners per core; C(n-1,2) cores => anchored active pairs < n^3, UNCONDITIONALLY and before any strip. This is the L3/n^3 rung for h=3 — PROVED. Sufficiency for the campaign still needs W4's rewiring (n^3 -> determination); the BOUND itself is now closed at h=3.
